title: Shipments and Labels: Ship, Track and Deliver Orders | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A paid order still has to be packed and sent. CrestApps shipments record what is in each parcel, the carrier and the tracking number, let you ship an order in parts, follow each parcel to delivery or return, and with EasyPost buy the label too, while buyers are emailed and can track their order.

In this video:
• Why shipments, and how they work from a paid order to a delivered parcel
• Creating a shipment: items, carrier, tracking number and link
• Being packed, Mark shipped, Delivered, Returned and Remove
• EasyPost: carrier rates, labels and tracking updates
• What buyers see: My Orders and Track your order
• Workflow events, emails and use cases
